corrections.resolution: Centralized purchasable eligibility permits active supplier-less legacy products and requires an active supplier for supplier-backed products. REST order preparation eager-loads and checks supplier eligibility under the product lock; WhatsApp SKU and exact-name resolution uses the same SQL scope. Regression tests cover direct product_id rejection plus supplier-less REST ordering, and stale WhatsApp reference rejection plus supplier-less WhatsApp ordering. Existing stock, idempotency, retry, and message-status semantics remain green.

cross_task_issues.resolution: The correction closes the previous bypass at both purchase boundaries. Direct REST product_id submission now rejects an active product owned by an inactive supplier without creating an order or decrementing stock. WhatsApp resolution excludes the same product by SKU or exact name, while an active supplier-less legacy product remains orderable. Marketplace and AI supplier filtering continue to agree with these rules.

cross_task_issues.description: PaymentController::index, SalesController::index, and DeliveryController::index still materialize complete histories with get(). This is a scale follow-up, not a demonstrated Phase 2 blocker at the tested fixture size.

verified: Supplier-less legacy products remain purchasable through REST and WhatsApp.
Supplier-backed products require active supplier subscription at REST order creation and WhatsApp product resolution; stale direct product_id and stale SKU/name references cannot bypass the boundary.

T4 payment/credit behavior, T5 analytics semantics and bounds, T6 delivery/order/payment consistency, T7 signed webhook and retry/idempotency behavior, T8 AI scope and sparse honesty, and T9 marketplace filtering/fixture/bounds remain integrated and green.
